$comment: ARIA SMART Objective card — v1.5 (Teams desktop and mobile).
Usage
This is a reference template, not a deployed artefact. The Teams bot populates
the `{{...}}` placeholders at runtime from the SmartObjective object returned by
POST /api/chat before sending the card to the Teams channel.
Placeholders
{{objective.objectiveText}}   string  — the full objective statement
{{objective.specific}}        string  — why it is specific (omit row if null)
{{objective.measurable}}      string  — how progress/success is measured (omit row if null)
{{objective.achievable}}      string  — why it is realistic for the role (omit row if null)
{{objective.relevant}}        string  — link to role/business priority (omit row if null)
{{objective.timeBound}}       string  — the deadline or period (omit row if null)
{{objective.policySourceUrls}} array   — canonical SharePoint URLs cited, if any
{{objective.*json*}}          string  — full SmartObjective serialised as JSON (for Action.Submit data)
Mobile behaviour
Teams renders Adaptive Cards in a single-column layout on mobile automatically.
The FactSet used for the SMART breakdown stacks label/value pairs vertically on narrow
screens. The regenerate Input.Text and submit buttons stack naturally on small screens.
Preset regenerate actions
The two ChoiceSet-backed quick actions ('Make it more measurable' and 'Add a timeframe')
let the user refine the objective in one tap without typing. Selecting one sets
regenerateInstruction to the matching preset text before Action.Submit fires; typing in
the free-text box overrides the preset.
Clipboard / copy-out
Teams Desktop: the bot handles the 'copy' Action.Submit and uses the
Microsoft Bot Framework Activity 'copyToClipboard' invoke to write to the clipboard.
Teams Mobile: fall back to showing objectiveText in a highlighted TextBlock that the
user can long-press to copy. This is handled by the bot, not by this card template.

body.$comment: SMART breakdown — omit any Fact whose corresponding field is null.
Policy sources — omit this Container entirely when policySourceUrls is empty.

items.$comment: Repeat one Action.OpenUrl per URL in objective.policySourceUrls at bot render time.
